description: Land Title Settlement Department - Weragoda, Galigamuwa D/S Division, Kegalle District - Cad. Map No. 610021 (7584)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title amendments under the Registration of Title Act, specifically addressing the expungement of particulars for multiple parcels of land in various locations.
